concept.hr: Od bloka do raspona i adresa za lokacije i VLAN-ove, s prostorom za rast
concept.en: From a block to ranges and addresses for sites and VLANs, with room to grow

summary.hr: Podijeli adresni blok na raspone za odjele, lokacije i VLAN-ove, dodaj rast i novi odjel, pogledaj kad prostor ne stane i napravi novi plan.
summary.en: Split an address block into ranges for departments, sites and VLANs, add growth and a new department, see it run out and re-plan.
